# Pull Request

## Summary

What does this PR change, and why?

## Related issue

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature / tool
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / internal cleanup
- [ ] Other

## How was this tested?

Describe the tests you ran and their result (e.g. `uv run pytest -m "not network"`).

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `uv run pytest -m "not network"` passes.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .` passes.
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests (where applicable).
- [ ] Documentation was updated (README / docs) if usage changed.
- [ ] No secrets or absolute local paths were committed.
